scored_but_failing_screen_in_this_file.question: Has the founder received any awards or honors during their education?

passing_screen_in_this_file_but_not_scor.question: Is the founder recognized for their public speaking or thought leadership?
Has the founder completed an MBA or similar advanced business degree?

question_chain.note: The screen keeps questions with validation precision >= 0.10 and recall >= 0.10. Recomputed on the shipped validation answers it does not match the 50 scored questions exactly (the lists above), so the release documents the 50 that were scored.

founders.note: Founder ids are the first 5 characters of an anonymised id, so 27 pairs of founders share an id and appear once. The answering run sent founders in batches of 20 and the last 4 founders were never sent, so the matrix has 8,177 - 4 = 8,173 founders.
